We equip retail, fashion, luxury, footwear, outdoor, home and consumer goods brands with pioneering best-of-breed solutions to plan, design, develop, source, comply, buy, make, price, allocate, sell and replenish products. Our technology powers brands to streamline processes, drive efficiency and operate with confidence in an ever-changing market. Our story is one of rapid growth, bold ideas and extraordinary opportunities. We’re here to challenge the status quo—and we’re looking for brilliant people who want to do the same. No matter where you are in the world, this is your chance to be part of something exceptional. Role Overview The IT Innovation and Transformation Specialist drives technology initiatives that improve productivity, security, and IT operations. This is a highly hands-on role requiring extensive professional experience and advanced technical proficiency across Microsoft 365, Azure, Entra ID, Intune, and Microsoft security technologies. The role focuses on modern workplace solutions, identity management, endpoint security, automation, AI adoption, and cross-platform management across Windows, macOS, Linux, mobile devices, SaaS applications, and cloud services. Key Responsibilities Innovation and Transformation Identify and implement technologies that improve productivity, efficiency, and user experience. Evaluate and adopt AI solutions, and emerging technologies. Develop proofs of concept and automate manual processes using modern tools and cloud services. Translate business needs into secure, scalable, and practical technology solutions. Microsoft 365, Azure and Identity Design, administer, and optimize Microsoft 365 and Azure services, including Exchange Online, SharePoint, Teams, and Microsoft Graph. Manage ldPs Entra ID/Okta, Conditional Access, MFA, privileged access, tenant governance, and identity lifecycle processes. Integrate SaaS applications with enterprise identity and access management platforms. Optimize licensing, cloud consumption, and service configurations. Endpoint Management and Modern Workplace Design and maintain endpoint management solutions for Windows, macOS, Linux, iOS/iPadOS, and Android using Intune and complementary technologies. Manage device provisioning, application deployment, configuration, compliance, security baselines, and remediation. Improve endpoint lifecycle management, standardization, and user experience through automation. Ensure endpoints remain secure, compliant, and aligned with enterprise requirements. Cybersecurity and Governance Partner closely with the Cybersecurity team to align IT initiatives with security strategy, policies, and risk management requirements. Embed security, privacy, and compliance by design across Microsoft 365, Azure, endpoints, and SaaS platforms. Support implementation and continuous improvement of Security Tools, Zero Trust, Conditional Access, least privilege, vulnerability management, and secure secrets handling. Collaborate on security assessments, remediation initiatives, incident response readiness, and governance improvements. Automation and Systems Integration Develop and maintain automation using PowerShell, Microsoft Graph API, Bash/shell scripting, Azure automation. Integrate enterprise platforms and services through APIs and modern authentication mechanisms. Reduce manual IT operations through reliable, reusable, and secure automation. Apply engineering best practices, including logging, error handling, testing, documentation, and maintainability. Architecture and Stakeholder Collaboration Contribute to IT strategy, technology roadmaps, architecture decisions, and continuous service improvement. Assess solutions based on security, scalability, operational complexity, cost, and business value. Work closely with IT, Cybersecurity, and business stakeholders to deliver aligned technology initiatives. Share technical knowledge and promote standardization, innovation, and continuous improvement. Required Experience And Technical Proficiency Extensive professional experience in enterprise IT, with strong hands-on engineering and problem-solving capabilities. Advanced technical proficiency in Microsoft 365, Azure, Entra ID, Intune, and related Microsoft technologies. Strong understanding of identity security, Zero Trust, endpoint protection, access governance, and enterprise security controls. Proven experience with PowerShell, Microsoft Graph, REST APIs, scripting, and automation. Experience managing Windows and macOS environments, with working knowledge of Linux and mobile platforms. Practical knowledge of Microsoft Defender, Purview, SaaS governance, and cloud operations. Ability to independently design, implement, troubleshoot, and optimize enterprise technology solutions. Strong analytical, communication, collaboration, and documentation skills. Success Measures Improved IT efficiency, productivity, and user experience. Stronger security posture and alignment with Cybersecurity requirements. Better utilization of Microsoft 365, Azure, and SaaS investments. More consistent and effective cross-platform endpoint management. Successful adoption of innovation, AI, and automation. Reduced operational overhead, complexity, and technology costs. Role Expectations This is a hands-on technical role requiring advanced technical proficiency, independent problem-solving, and ownership of solutions from design through implementation and optimization. The successful candidate will combine technical depth with strategic thinking, strong collaboration with the Cybersecurity team, and a focus on delivering secure, scalable, and business-aligned technology solutions. Compensation And Benefits The anticipated base salary range for this position is €45,000 - €60,000 per year. Actual compensation will be determined based on factors such as the candidate’s experience, skills, qualifications, and work location. Centric offers a comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental and vision coverage, paid time off, and other applicable benefits, subject to applicable plan terms and eligibility requirements. Applications in English Centric Software provides equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants without regard to race, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, color, age, religion, protected veteran or disability status or genetic information.

matched_queries.query: Middle East and Africa IT support

review_candidates.description: Location: Belfast, United Kingdom Thales is a global technology leader with more than 83,000 employees on five continents. With over 7,500 people in the UK, operating across defence, space, aerospace, and digital security, we help build a future we can all trust. Thales supports the security and stability of our nation by providing extraordinary technology to our customers, as well as delivering social value to the UK with our products and services. Thales technology makes it possible for two thirds of planes to take off and land safely. Thales also protects 80% of the world’s payment card transactions and is Europe’s number one supplier of defence electronics. Beyond that our people have made London’s Jubilee and Northern Lines 20% more efficient and have delivered more than 300 air defence radars in 26 countries. We are a leading name in our markets and a diverse, constantly evolving organisation. Join us. We are currently looking to recruit an End User Support Technician to join our team in Belfast . The role will assist the support of the IT infrastructure covering around 2000 users in a multi network environment providing desktop support services. Key Responsibilities and Tasks: Provide desktop support (2nd/3rd Line) to user calls, fed via the UK Service Desk / Activity Controllers to EUS staff. (Includes the resolution of incidents up to Priority One level and handling Service Requests from basic Laptop/desktop builds to entire user IT relocation projects). Build / rebuild and deployment of desktop / laptop machines in line with “Desktop-on-Demand” procedures and build standards using automated tools (SCCM) and manual processes as necessary. Ensure appropriate support is provided within contractual support hours (the minimum hours per week will be 37 – (8hrs Mon to Thu and 5hrs Fri). However, a flexible attitude to work hours is expected and may require evening and weekend work on occasion. The candidate should be available for on-call if required. Incident support and troubleshooting of any reported issues raised by a UK based service desk on behalf of users. Support and deployment of Smartphone’s - iPhone and Android. Support and cover a kiosk-based support solution to troubleshoot IT requests at a drop-in centre based in the Belfast sites giving the customer flexibility for the support provided. Qualifications, Experience and Skills: Experience working in an IT support environment working directly with users in face-to-face situations. Ability to diagnose faults and think on their feet to find a solution. Experience with desktop/laptop environments covering Windows 11, Windows 10, Office applications. Skills with engineering and bespoke desktop applications desirable. Ability to interact with users at all levels including senior VIPs. Resilience to challenging feedback and able to show sympathetic but firm and positive responses. Teamwork focus, able to work with teams located at other remote sites as required. Ability to prioritise and action calls in busy user environment and to take on work delegated by central Service Desk Ability to identify and suggest where team and processes could develop and enhance levels of service to users and IS internally A highly flexible attitude is required where the ability to take on tasks and travel to other sites in the region at short notice is needed. Knowledge of the following: Desktop Support experience (Windows 11 / Windows 10), Fault-Finding and Troubleshooting skills, User Administration, Cisco AnyConnect support, SCCM, Bitlocker, VMware Horizon, Active Directory, Software Installation, Laptop / Desktop / Virtual desktop builds Desirable: Automation tools (such as SCCM) Network patching and Cable Tracing Hardware Installation/Troubleshooting iOS / Android / Phone Support Good knowledge of – IP, WINS, DHCP, DNS, Group Policy etc. At Thales, we ensure equal opportunities, pay and working conditions for all. The benefits we offer include private medical insurance, buying or selling annual leave, cycle to work schemes, employee discounts, paid volunteering day, stocks and shares, annual bonus and much more depending on the role. Read more about our benefits here. We are committed to creating a workplace where everyone feels valued for who they are and the unique strengths they bring. Discover more about our programmes, employee networks, wellbeing policies, and inclusive features here. If this role isn’t quite right for you, we encourage you to join our talent community where your details will be shared with our recruitment teams for other potential opportunities. Join the Talent Community here. Join Thales in the UK – Innovate with us and shape the future!

CORE INFRA - Associate Lead Consultant Job Date: Nov 14, 2026 Job Requisition Id: 67005 Location: Bangalore, KA, IN Bangalore, KA, IN Experience 8-10 Years Job Description Role summary Site execution. Builds and validates the new PowerEdge + PowerStore clusters on vSphere 9.x after Dell's handover, migrates workloads off VxRail, runs cutovers in each site's maintenance window, and performs the rolling host upgrades on the clusters that keep their hardware. Executes IQ/OQ protocols and captures the evidence. Key Responsibilities Site readiness: current-state discovery, prerequisite packs (rack, power, cabling, VLAN/IP, PowerStore connectivity, DNS/NTP/AD/certificates), change requests. Post-handover build: cluster build or join under vCenter 9.x, host profiles, HA/DRS/EVC, distributed switch and VMkernel config, PowerStore volume and datastore presentation, multipathing verification. Backup re-registration in Avamar and Veeam with Data Domain, retention mapping, restore verification. Workload migration: migration matrix per workload, vMotion / Storage vMotion / cross-vCenter / cold migration, cutover execution in approved windows, post-cutover validation and hypercare. Rolling host upgrades 8.0 U3 to 9.x via VxRail Manager or vLCM, standalone host upgrade with coordinated VM shutdown, post-upgrade validation. Execute approved IQ/OQ protocols; capture configuration exports, screenshots, logs and validation results; compile the qualification package. Logical decommissioning of retired VxRail clusters; as-built documentation and runbook updates. Required Technical/ Functional Competencies Must-have Experience 8 to 12 years hands-on VMware vSphere administration and engineering, with vSphere 7 and 8 in production; exposure to vSphere 9.x or VCF 9. Dell VxRail operations (VxRail Manager, LCM) and PowerEdge; PowerStore or comparable external block/file storage provisioning to ESXi. Has executed workload migrations and cutovers in production, including EVC and Storage vMotion, and knows the failure modes. Has executed IQ/OQ or equivalent test protocols and captured evidence to a documented standard. Comfortable working night and weekend windows on rotation for US and European sites. Good to have VCP-DCV 2023/2024 or later. Veeam VMCE or Avamar administration. PowerShell/PowerCLI automation of build validation. Prior pharma or GxP site work. Required Behavioral Competencies Accountability: Takes responsibility for and ensures accuracy of results and deadlines of the function and/or team and in completing own work. Collaboration: Reaches out to others in team to ensure connections are made and team members are working together. Looks for ways to integrate work with other teams, identifying similarities and opportunities, making necessary changes in work to ensure successful integration. Agility: Demonstrates openness to the possibilities that change presents and begins to plan for how role may change. Works with others to prepare for change. Customer Focus: Identifies trends and patterns emerging from customer preferences and works towards customizing/ refining existing services to exceed customer needs and expectations. Communication: Communicates well-organized ideas, information, and data to broad and diverse audiences across the Organization (through formal and informal presentations). Helps others identify their appropriate audience. Drives Results: Sets realistic stretch goals for self & others and perseveres to follow through with resilience and remains calm in a crisis or stressful situation to exceed organization/client expectation.
